_comment: Bundled free game library. Every title is homebrew / open source / freeware or was released for free non-commercial use by its rights holder. Sources: RetroArch Content Downloader (buildbot.libretro.com/assets/cores), mamedev.org/roms, the authors' GitHub repositories. No commercial ROMs are, or will ever be, bundled.

games.author: tsone
games.desc: The addictive sliding-tile puzzle, on the NES. Join the numbers to reach 2048.

games.name: Nova the Squirrel
games.author: NovaSquirrel
games.desc: A full-length platformer: Nova copies abilities from enemies to cross a strange world. One of the best modern NES homebrews.

games.name: Alter Ego
games.author: Shiru
games.desc: Puzzle-platformer: swap places with your phantom twin to reach every pixel. 25 levels.

games.name: Spacegulls
games.author: Morphcat Games
games.desc: Fast-paced action platformer with a squad of seagulls in space. NESdev competition winner.

games.name: Super Boss Gaiden
games.author: Dieter von Laser / Chilly Willy
games.desc: Ninja-Gaiden-style action homebrew for the Super Famicom, with cutscenes and a cinematic intro.

games.name: N-Warp Daisakusen
games.author: d4s
games.desc: Up to 8-player deathmatch brawler (multitap) — a technical showcase of the SNES.

games.name: Kumi-Daiko Beatoff 64
games.author: Team Riistahillo (N64brew Game Jam 2020)
games.desc: Whip-fest arena game for up to four players: pick an animal mask, swing your drum, knock out angry masks in Survival or fight friends in Battle. Runner-up of the first N64brew Game Jam. Stick = move, A = select, Start = stop round.

games.name: Tobu Tobu Girl
games.author: Tangram Games
games.desc: Arcade platformer: dash, double-jump and catch your cat. Speedrun-friendly with time attack.

games.name: Deadeus
games.author: -IZMA-
games.desc: Horror adventure: you have 3 days before the village ends. 11 endings, made with GB Studio.

games.name: Celeste Classic
games.author: Maddy Thorson & Noel Berry · GBA port by JeffRuLz
games.desc: The original PICO-8 Celeste, ported to the Game Boy Advance. 30 screens of precision platforming.

games.name: Cave Story MD
games.author: Studio Pixel · port by andwn
games.desc: Complete fan port of the classic freeware Metroidvania to the Mega Drive. Long, superb, definitive.

games.name: Ultimate Tetris
games.author: Haroldo O. Pinheiro
games.desc: Fully featured Tetris with several modes, 2-player versus and music, written with SGDK.

games.name: Break An Egg
games.author: Studio Vetea
games.desc: Breakout with a chicken. Simple, colourful and very Mega Drive.

games.name: 6-Button Controller Test
games.author: Charles MacDonald
games.desc: Diagnostic cartridge: shows every button of a 3/6-button pad live. Handy to check your gamepad mapping.

games.name: Button Test
games.author: libretro
games.desc: Game Gear input tester — lights up the buttons you press.

games.name: Sheep It Up!
games.author: Dr. Ludos
games.desc: Help a sheep climb higher and higher by grabbing velcro strips. Tiny 4 KB arcade gem.

games.name: Swan Driving
games.author: Sebastian Mihai
games.desc: A little driving game for the WonderSwan Color: dodge the cars, rack up points.

games.name: 240p Test Suite (PC Engine)
games.author: Artemio Urbina
games.desc: The classic homebrew display-calibration suite: colour bars, grids, scroll tests, manual lag test, sound test and more — a real HuCard program that exercises the PC Engine core fully. RUN = help, d-pad = navigate.

games.name: Handy Rogue
games.author: james7780
games.desc: Tiny roguelike: 10 random dungeons, swords, gold and monsters, on the Atari Lynx.

games.name: BlueRetro Jaguar Pad Test
games.author: Jacques Gagnon (darthcloud)
games.desc: Live controller diagnostic built with JagStudio: shows the frame counter, detected pad type (standard / Team Tap / 6D) and every button/keypad state in real time. Not a game, but the only open-source Jaguar binary that renders reliably on the Virtual Jaguar WASM core — ideal for checking the app's Jaguar input mapping.

games.name: Asteroids neo
games.author: Steven MacDonald (studioNOTsnk)
games.desc: Vector-style Asteroids for the Neo Geo Pocket Color, with hyperspace and UFOs.

games.name: PSX Test Program
games.author: libretro
games.desc: PlayStation controller & video test executable. Boots without a BIOS in most cores — useful to verify the PSX core works.

games.name: Cube Test (PSP)
games.author: PPSSPP
games.desc: The PSP SDK spinning-cube sample: confirms the PSP core, WebGL2 and threads are all working on this machine.

games.name: Saturn Demo (Yabause sample)
games.author: Yabause project
games.desc: Yabause's own sample disc image (cue + iso + audio track) that boots without a BIOS: shows the RetroArch demo screen with date/time, memory usage and a bouncing logo. Proves the Saturn core, CD mounting and multi-track cue handling work.

games.name: Alien Arena
games.author: Duncan Brown
games.license: Free for home use (author's permission) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Unreleased Williams-hardware arcade game (Robotron board) — a frantic 2-player arena shooter released by its author for free home use.

games.name: Gridlee
games.author: Videa
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Videa founders) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Bounce around a grid catching balls and dodging bugs. The only prototype of this Videa game survived.

games.name: Robby Roto
games.author: Bally/Midway
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Jamie Fenton) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Dig tunnels, rescue hostages and avoid the aliens. Released for free by its designer.

games.name: Circus
games.author: Exidy
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Exidy) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Bounce clowns off a see-saw to pop balloons. One of the first colour-overlay hits.

games.name: Rip Cord
games.author: Exidy
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Exidy) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Skydive from a plane, steer past helicopters and pull the rip cord in time to land on the moving target below. Colour-overlay Exidy classic.

games.name: Fire One!
games.author: Exidy
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Exidy) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Two-player submarine duel through a periscope: sonar sweep, torpedoes and a split-screen ocean. Uses MAME's dual analog dials → mapped to the d-pad.

games.name: Super Tank
games.author: Video Games GmbH
games.license: Free non-commercial use — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Top-down tank combat through minefields. German arcade rarity.

games.name: Side Trak
games.author: Exidy
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Exidy) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Drive a train around a spiral track, laying rails to dodge the pursuing engines. Early Exidy maze game — simple, fast and a good input-latency check.

games.name: Targ
games.author: Exidy
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Exidy) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Drive the Wummel through a grid city, ramming Targs before they ram you.

games.name: Spectar
games.author: Exidy
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Exidy) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Follow-up to Targ: the same grid, meaner Rammers and the shooting Spectar.

games.name: Star Fire
games.author: Exidy
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Exidy) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: The first sit-down cockpit arcade game: a first-person space dogfight with a shield/fuel HUD and a famous vector-looking 'Star Fire' title. Insert coin (5), Start (1); arrows steer, Z fires.

games.name: Car Polo
games.author: Exidy
games.license: Free non-commercial use (Exidy) — distributed by mamedev.org only, fetched at build time
games.desc: Four cars, one ball, two goals. Multiplayer polo on wheels from 1977.

games.name: Commander Keen 4: Secret of the Oracle (shareware)
games.author: id Software / Apogee
games.desc: The classic shareware episode: Keen pogo-sticks through the Shadowlands to rescue the Council Members. Auto-starts into the game (bundled dosbox.conf); F10 fast-forwards.

games.name: Wolfenstein 3D (shareware)
games.author: id Software / Apogee
games.desc: Escape from Castle Wolfenstein — the game that started the FPS genre. Shareware episode 1, ten levels. Auto-starts into the game (bundled dosbox.conf).

note: Bundled free library. Entries flagged restricted:true are NOT committed to the repository: they are fetched from mamedev.org by scripts/download-roms.js (rights holders allow distribution on that site only). Everything else is homebrew/open-source/freeware redistributed under the terms listed in LICENSES.md.
